title: 人工智能，从零搭建 · 第14部分：语言模型的谱系

chapters.Hook: 从一篇翻译论文到开放前沿
chapters.Translation: 1. 注意力就是你所需要的一切
chapters.BERT: 3. 掩码语言模型与基准时代
chapters.GPT2: 5. 无监督的多任务学习者
chapters.GPT3: 6. 规模，以及在上下文中学习
chapters.Emergence: 14. 在我们自己的模型里，在上下文中学习

a8554372dc92.en: June 2017. Eight researchers at Google publish a paper with a confident title: Attention Is All You Need. <bookmark mark='a'/> Their model translates English into German and French. The larger version has 213 million parameters, and it trained for three and a half days on eight graphics cards. <bookmark mark='b'/> Here is every model this part will meet, placed by the date it appeared and by its size, on a scale where each step up is ten times more. <bookmark mark='c'/> By November 2022, the same building block, made much larger, was answering questions for anyone who asked: ChatGPT. <bookmark mark='d'/> And by the autumn of 2026, models you can download and run yourself have trillions of parameters. Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 has 2.8 trillion, about 13,000 times the 2017 Transformer.
a8554372dc92.zh: 2017年6月。谷歌的八位研究者发表了一篇标题很自信的论文：《Attention Is All You Need》，注意力就是你所需要的一切。<bookmark mark='a'/>他们的模型把英语翻译成德语和法语。较大的那个版本有2.13亿个参数，在8块显卡上训练了三天半。<bookmark mark='b'/>这里是本部分会遇到的每一个模型，按它出现的时间和它的大小排开，纵轴每往上一格就是10倍。<bookmark mark='c'/>到2022年11月，同样的基本模块，做得大得多，开始回答任何人的提问：ChatGPT。<bookmark mark='d'/>而到2026年秋天，你可以下载、自己运行的模型已经有上万亿个参数。月之暗面的Kimi K3有2.8万亿个参数，大约是2017年那个Transformer的13000倍。

cbeec0d357ea.en: How did a model built to translate sentences become the engine of nearly everything? That is the story of this part. <bookmark mark='a'/> It runs from the translation Transformer, through GPT and BERT, T5, GPT-2 and GPT-3, to ChatGPT, and on to the open-weight models of today. <bookmark mark='b'/> At each step we'll ask who built what, and when; what the step changed; and why it worked.
cbeec0d357ea.zh: 一个为翻译句子而造的模型，怎么就成了几乎一切的引擎？这就是本部分要讲的故事。<bookmark mark='a'/>它从做翻译的Transformer开始，经过GPT和BERT、T5、GPT-2和GPT-3，到ChatGPT，再到今天的开放权重模型。<bookmark mark='b'/>每一步，我们都会问：谁在什么时候做了什么；这一步改变了什么；它为什么奏效。

6d5478e2d08c.en: Along the way we'll rebuild the lineage in miniature, on the computer making this video, with the thirty novels this series reads. <bookmark mark='a'/> A GPT-style model, which learns to predict the next word, and a BERT-style model, which learns to fill in blanks, of exactly the same size, trained with exactly the same compute, and compared fairly. <bookmark mark='b'/> And a family of GPT-style models of growing size, from 274 thousand to 4.2 million parameters, to see whether learning from examples in the prompt, the surprise of GPT-3, shows up at our scale.
6d5478e2d08c.zh: 一路上，我们会在这台制作视频的电脑上，用本系列读的那三十部小说，把这条谱系缩小重建一遍。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个GPT式的模型，学着预测下一个词；一个BERT式的模型，学着填空；两者大小完全相同，训练用的算力完全相同，比较也力求公平。<bookmark mark='b'/>再加上一族大小递增的GPT式模型，从大约27万到420万个参数，看看从提示里的例子中学习，也就是GPT-3带来的惊喜，在我们这个规模上会不会出现。

b262b9eaea52.en: This is Part 14 of AI, Built, in its third act, the transformer era. <bookmark mark='a'/> In this part: the 2017 Transformer, and the three ways to cut it; pretraining, from ULMFiT and GPT-1 to BERT and T5; scale, from GPT-2 to GPT-3, and learning from the prompt; how a predictor of text became an assistant; open weights, the design they converged on, and the frontier of 2026; the trends in compute, cost and data; and our own experiments.
b262b9eaea52.zh: 这是《人工智能，从零搭建》的第14部分，属于第三幕：Transformer时代。<bookmark mark='a'/>本部分讲：2017年的Transformer，以及切分它的三种方式；预训练，从ULMFiT和GPT-1到BERT和T5；规模，从GPT-2到GPT-3，以及从提示中学习；一个文本预测器怎样变成了助手；开放权重，它们趋同的设计，以及2026年的前沿；算力、成本和数据的趋势；还有我们自己的实验。

d640f1c7aaeb.en: Chapter one. Attention is all you need.
d640f1c7aaeb.zh: 第1章。注意力就是你所需要的一切。

81e2a58f7de5.en: In 2017 the best translation systems were recurrent networks, the sequence-to-sequence models of Part 10, with attention added on. They read a sentence one word at a time: the state after each word is computed from the state after the word before. <bookmark mark='a'/> That chain is the problem. Training can't run the steps of one sentence in parallel, and the last word reaches the first only through every state in between. <bookmark mark='b'/> The Transformer dropped the recurrence. Every position attends to every other position directly, all at once: a whole sentence goes through a layer in one parallel step, and any two words are a single hop apart.
81e2a58f7de5.zh: 2017年，最好的翻译系统是循环网络，也就是第10部分讲的序列到序列模型，再加上注意力。它们一次读一个词：读完每个词之后的状态，由读完前一个词之后的状态算出来。<bookmark mark='a'/>问题就出在这条链上。训练时，一个句子的各步没法并行，最后一个词要碰到第一个词，必须经过中间的每一个状态。<bookmark mark='b'/>Transformer去掉了循环。每个位置直接关注其他每个位置，一次全部完成：整个句子通过一层只需一个并行步骤，任意两个词之间只隔一跳。

3325e2bebb75.en: Here is the model they built. <bookmark mark='a'/> An encoder reads the English sentence: six identical layers, each with self-attention, where every word looks at every other word, followed by a small feed-forward network applied to each position on its own. <bookmark mark='b'/> A decoder writes the German, one token at a time, with six layers of its own. Its self-attention is masked, so a position sees only the words already written. <bookmark mark='c'/> And a third sub-layer, cross-attention, lets each position of the output look at the encoded input. <bookmark mark='d'/> Around every sub-layer, a residual connection and layer normalization; and to tell the model where each word is, sine waves of many frequencies, added to the inputs. Part 13 took this machine apart. Here we care about what it became.
3325e2bebb75.zh: 这就是他们造的模型。<bookmark mark='a'/>编码器读入英语句子：六个相同的层，每层先是自注意力，每个词看其他每个词，然后是一个小的前馈网络，分别作用在每个位置上。<bookmark mark='b'/>解码器写出德语，一次一个词元，它也有自己的六层。它的自注意力带掩码，所以一个位置只能看到已经写出的词。<bookmark mark='c'/>还有第三个子层，交叉注意力，让输出的每个位置去看编码后的输入。<bookmark mark='d'/>每个子层外面，都有残差连接和层归一化；为了告诉模型每个词在哪里，还把不同频率的正弦波加到输入上。第13部分已经把这台机器拆开看过了。这里我们关心的是它后来变成了什么。

a96a4168be7d.en: The paper gave two configurations. <bookmark mark='a'/> The base model: six layers in each stack, a width of 512, eight attention heads, 65 million parameters, trained for a hundred thousand steps, about twelve hours. The big model doubles the width and the heads: 213 million parameters, three hundred thousand steps, three and a half days. Both trained on the standard data of the 2014 Workshop on Machine Translation: four and a half million English–German sentence pairs, and thirty-six million English–French. <bookmark mark='b'/> On English to German, the big model scored 28.4 BLEU, a measure of overlap with human translations, more than two points above the best earlier systems, ensembles included. <bookmark mark='c'/> And it was cheap. The base model alone beat every earlier system, at a training cost about a seventh of Google's own recurrent system.
a96a4168be7d.zh: 论文给出了两种配置。<bookmark mark='a'/>基础模型：每个堆栈六层，宽度512，8个注意力头，6500万个参数，训练10万步，大约12个小时。大模型把宽度和头数都翻倍：2.13亿个参数，30万步，三天半。两者都用2014年机器翻译研讨会的标准数据训练：450万对英德句子，3600万句英法句子。<bookmark mark='b'/>英译德，大模型得到28.4的BLEU分，这是衡量与人工译文重合程度的指标，比之前最好的系统，包括集成模型，高出两分多。<bookmark mark='c'/>而且它很便宜。仅仅基础模型就超过了之前的所有系统，训练成本大约只有谷歌自家循环系统的七分之一。

d1d8047c3759.en: Where does a number like that come from? The paper's recipe is worth seeing, because the field still counts compute this way. <bookmark mark='a'/> Training time: three and a half days is 302,400 seconds. <bookmark mark='b'/> Times the number of GPUs, eight, times what one GPU sustains: the authors assumed 9.5 trillion operations a second for the P100. <bookmark mark='c'/> The product is about 2.3 times ten to the nineteen operations, the figure in their table. <bookmark mark='d'/> In chapter six we'll count the same thing a second way, from the model's size and the number of tokens it read.
d1d8047c3759.zh: 这样的数字是怎么来的？论文的算法值得一看，因为这个领域至今还是这样计算算力的。<bookmark mark='a'/>训练时间：三天半是302400秒。<bookmark mark='b'/>乘以GPU的数量，8块，再乘以一块GPU能持续的速度：作者假设P100每秒9.5万亿次运算。<bookmark mark='c'/>乘积大约是2.3乘以10的19次方次运算，正是他们表里的数字。<bookmark mark='d'/>在第6章，我们会用第二种方法算同一个量：根据模型的大小，和它读过的词元数。

629cf2cf252c.en: Why did it win? Three reasons, and each matters more as we go. Every position is computed at once, so training uses parallel hardware fully. Any word reaches any other in a single step, so long-range dependencies are easy to learn. And the work is almost all matrix multiplication, which is exactly what graphics cards are built for, the subject of Part 17. <bookmark mark='a'/> The encoder–decoder was built for translation. Within eighteen months the field had cut it three ways: keep only the encoder, as BERT did; keep only the decoder, as GPT did; or keep both, as T5 did. <bookmark mark='b'/> Which cut won, and why, is the thread of this part.
629cf2cf252c.zh: 它为什么赢了？有三个原因，而且越往后越重要。每个位置同时计算，所以训练能充分利用并行硬件。任意一个词一步就能到达任意另一个词，所以长距离的依赖容易学到。而且计算几乎全是矩阵乘法，这正是显卡擅长的，那是第17部分的主题。<bookmark mark='a'/>编码器-解码器是为翻译而造的。不到十八个月，这个领域就把它切成了三种：只保留编码器，像BERT那样；只保留解码器，像GPT那样；或者两者都保留，像T5那样。<bookmark mark='b'/>哪一种切法赢了，为什么，是本部分的主线。

46f9b712c15e.en: In 2017, almost every language task trained its own model, from scratch, on its own labelled data. A benchmark for sentence understanding, GLUE, collected eight such tasks; their training sets range from four hundred thousand examples down to two and a half thousand. <bookmark mark='a'/> Labels are expensive. Raw text is nearly free: billions of words of books and encyclopedias. <bookmark mark='b'/> Computer vision had already found the way to use the free kind: train one network on ImageNet, then fine-tune it for each new task. <bookmark mark='c'/> In 2018 language did the same. Pretrain on raw text with an objective that needs no labels, the guessing game of Part 1, then fine-tune a copy on each task.
46f9b712c15e.zh: 2017年，几乎每个语言任务都要从零开始，用自己的标注数据训练自己的模型。一个句子理解的基准GLUE，收集了八个这样的任务；它们的训练集，从40万个例子到2500个不等。<bookmark mark='a'/>标注很贵。原始文本几乎免费：几十亿词的书和百科全书。<bookmark mark='b'/>计算机视觉已经找到了利用免费数据的办法：先在ImageNet上训练一个网络，再为每个新任务微调它。<bookmark mark='c'/>2018年，语言也这样做了。先用一个不需要标注的目标在原始文本上预训练，也就是第1部分的猜字游戏，再为每个任务微调一个副本。

a0683382842e.en: January 2018: Jeremy Howard and Sebastian Ruder's ULMFiT. They pretrained a recurrent language model on Wikipedia, a hundred and three million words, then fine-tuned it on text classification, carefully, layer by layer. It cut the error of the best systems by 18 to 24 percent, and with only a hundred labelled examples it matched training from scratch on a hundred times as many. <bookmark mark='a'/> February 2018: ELMo, from the Allen Institute and the University of Washington. Two language models, one reading forward and one backward, whose internal states became word vectors that depend on the sentence. <bookmark mark='b'/> The bank of a river and the bank that sets interest rates get different vectors. Added to existing models, they improved the best results on six different tasks.
a0683382842e.zh: 2018年1月：杰里米·霍华德和塞巴斯蒂安·鲁德的ULMFiT。他们在维基百科上预训练了一个循环语言模型，1.03亿个词，然后在文本分类上微调，小心地一层一层来。它把最好系统的错误率降低了18%到24%，而且只用100个标注例子，就达到了从零开始用100倍数据训练的效果。<bookmark mark='a'/>2018年2月：艾伦人工智能研究所和华盛顿大学的ELMo。两个语言模型，一个从前往后读，一个从后往前读，它们的内部状态变成了随句子而变的词向量。<bookmark mark='b'/>河岸的bank和设定利率的银行bank，得到不同的向量。把它们加进已有的模型，在六个不同的任务上都提高了最好成绩。

3c2d792efc78.en: June 2018: OpenAI's GPT, by Alec Radford and colleagues. Instead of a recurrent network, the Transformer's decoder alone. <bookmark mark='a'/> Twelve layers, a width of 768, twelve heads, 117 million parameters, pretrained on BooksCorpus, over seven thousand unpublished books, to predict the next token from the 512 before it. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then one model is fine-tuned for each task, with every input written as a single sequence: for entailment, the premise, a delimiter, the hypothesis; for multiple choice, the context with each answer in turn. A new linear layer reads the last position. <bookmark mark='c'/> It set a new state of the art on nine of the twelve tasks it was tested on.
3c2d792efc78.zh: 2018年6月：OpenAI的GPT，作者是亚历克·拉德福德和同事。他们不用循环网络，只用Transformer的解码器。<bookmark mark='a'/>12层，宽度768，12个头，1.17亿个参数，在BooksCorpus上预训练，也就是七千多本未出版的书，根据前面的512个词元预测下一个词元。<bookmark mark='b'/>然后为每个任务微调一个模型，每个输入都写成一个序列：做蕴含判断，就是前提、一个分隔符、假设；做多项选择，就是上下文依次接上每个答案。一个新的线性层读取最后一个位置。<bookmark mark='c'/>它在测试的12个任务中，有9个创下了新的最好成绩。

9b7089ed322b.en: Written as objectives: <bookmark mark='a'/> pretraining maximizes the log-probability of each token given the ones before it, the chain rule of Part 1 on raw text. <bookmark mark='b'/> Fine-tuning maximizes the log-probability of the right label given the input sequence. <bookmark mark='c'/> And GPT kept the first objective on as a helper while fine-tuning, <bookmark mark='d'/> weighted by one half: it made learning faster and the result generalize better. <bookmark mark='e'/> Pretrain once, fine-tune many times: that was the recipe of 2018.
9b7089ed322b.zh: 写成目标函数：<bookmark mark='a'/>预训练最大化每个词元在给定前面词元时的对数概率，也就是第1部分的链式法则，用在原始文本上。<bookmark mark='b'/>微调最大化给定输入序列时正确标签的对数概率。<bookmark mark='c'/>GPT在微调时还把第一个目标保留下来作为辅助，<bookmark mark='d'/>权重是二分之一：这让学习更快，结果的泛化也更好。<bookmark mark='e'/>预训练一次，微调多次：这就是2018年的配方。

3c1a19f5d488.en: What remained open was the objective. GPT predicts from left to right, so each word's representation is built only from the words before it. <bookmark mark='a'/> For tasks like question answering, where the meaning of a word can depend on what comes after it, that looked like a handicap. <bookmark mark='b'/> Four months later, Google had an answer: BERT.
3c1a19f5d488.zh: 还没定下来的是目标函数。GPT从左往右预测，所以每个词的表示只由它前面的词构成。<bookmark mark='a'/>对于问答这样的任务，一个词的意思可能取决于它后面的内容，这看起来是个缺陷。<bookmark mark='b'/>四个月后，谷歌给出了答案：BERT。

32cbbf98b251.en: Chapter three. Masked language models, and the benchmark era.
32cbbf98b251.zh: 第3章。掩码语言模型，与基准时代。

ab385fd5541c.en: October 2018: Jacob Devlin, Ming-Wei Chang, Kenton Lee and Kristina Toutanova at Google. BERT keeps the Transformer's encoder alone, so every position sees the whole input, both ways. <bookmark mark='a'/> But a model that sees everything can't be trained to predict the next word: it would simply look at it. So BERT hides words instead. Pick fifteen percent of the positions at random. <bookmark mark='b'/> Replace eighty percent of those with a special mask token, ten percent with a random word, and leave ten percent unchanged. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then train the model to recover the original word at each picked position. The random and unchanged words matter: when the model is later fine-tuned there are no mask tokens, so it can't afford to think hard only where it sees one. <bookmark mark='d'/> A second task asked whether one passage really follows another.
ab385fd5541c.zh: 2018年10月：谷歌的雅各布·德夫林和同事。BERT只保留Transformer的编码器，所以每个位置都能看到整个输入，两个方向都能看。<bookmark mark='a'/>但一个能看到一切的模型，没法训练它预测下一个词：它直接看一眼就行了。所以BERT改为把词藏起来。随机挑出15%的位置。<bookmark mark='b'/>其中80%换成一个特殊的掩码词元，10%换成一个随机词，10%保持不变。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后训练模型，在每个挑出的位置上恢复原来的词。随机词和不变的词很重要：之后微调模型时，输入里没有掩码词元，所以它不能只在看到掩码的地方才用心。<bookmark mark='d'/>第二个任务，是判断一段话是否真的接在另一段后面。

09d28e84d81c.en: Put the two objectives side by side. <bookmark mark='a'/> A left-to-right model like GPT makes every position a target, predicted from the words before it. <bookmark mark='b'/> The masked model's loss sums only over the picked positions, each predicted from the whole corrupted sentence. <bookmark mark='c'/> On average that is fifteen percent of the positions, <bookmark mark='d'/> so per sequence of text, the left-to-right model gets about six and a half times as many targets to learn from. <bookmark mark='e'/> BERT's authors measured the cost: their masked model learned slightly more slowly, step for step, but overtook a left-to-right model on the tasks almost immediately. We'll test that claim ourselves in chapter thirteen.
09d28e84d81c.zh: 把两个目标放在一起看。<bookmark mark='a'/>像GPT这样从左往右的模型，让每个位置都成为目标，用它前面的词来预测。<bookmark mark='b'/>掩码模型的损失只对挑出的位置求和，每个都由整个被破坏的句子来预测。<bookmark mark='c'/>平均下来，那是15%的位置，<bookmark mark='d'/>所以同样一段文本，从左往右的模型能学的目标大约是它的6.5倍。<bookmark mark='e'/>BERT的作者测量过这个代价：他们的掩码模型按步数来看学得稍慢一点，但几乎马上就在任务上超过了从左往右的模型。我们会在第13章亲自检验这个说法。

722c0ede37c1.en: BERT came in two sizes. Base: twelve layers and 110 million parameters, the same size as GPT, chosen so the two could be compared. Large: twenty-four layers and 340 million. Both trained on books and English Wikipedia, 3.3 billion words, for a million steps. <bookmark mark='a'/> On the GLUE leaderboard BERT-Large scored 80.5, against GPT's 72.8, and it set new records in question answering too. <bookmark mark='b'/> Better still, the authors checked where the gain came from. They pretrained the same Base model a second way, left to right like GPT, everything else equal. <bookmark mark='c'/> Masking won on all five tasks, by a little on sentiment, and by about 10 points on question answering, where seeing the words after a word matters most.
722c0ede37c1.zh: BERT有两种大小。Base：12层，1.1亿个参数，和GPT一样大，这样两者才能比较。Large：24层，3.4亿个参数。两者都用书和英文维基百科训练，33亿个词，训练一百万步。<bookmark mark='a'/>在GLUE排行榜上，BERT-Large得到80.5分，GPT是72.8分；它在问答上也创了新纪录。<bookmark mark='b'/>更好的是，作者检查了提升从哪里来。他们用第二种方式预训练同一个Base模型：像GPT一样从左往右，其他一切都相同。<bookmark mark='c'/>掩码在全部五个任务上都赢了：在情感分析上只赢一点点，在问答上赢了大约10分，而在问答里，看到一个词后面的词最重要。

1e3501faa3a6.en: BERT started a race on the benchmarks. <bookmark mark='a'/> GLUE combined nine tasks into one score; by July 2019 the best system had passed the estimate of human performance. <bookmark mark='b'/> So a harder benchmark, SuperGLUE, was built, with a human score of 89.8; BERT scored 69. Within months it too was nearly solved. <bookmark mark='c'/> RoBERTa, from Facebook, showed that BERT had simply been undertrained: drop the second task, train longer on more data, and it matched everything published after it. <bookmark mark='d'/> ELECTRA let a small network replace words and trained the main one to spot the replacements, so it learned from every position, not fifteen percent. <bookmark mark='e'/> Encoders ruled language understanding for two years, and they never went away: the embedding models behind search and retrieval are mostly encoders.
1e3501faa3a6.zh: BERT开启了一场在基准上的竞赛。<bookmark mark='a'/>GLUE把九个任务合成一个分数；到2019年7月，最好的系统已经超过了对人类水平的估计。<bookmark mark='b'/>于是人们建了一个更难的基准SuperGLUE，人类得分89.8；BERT只有69分。几个月之内，它也几乎被攻克了。<bookmark mark='c'/>Facebook的RoBERTa表明，BERT只是训练得不够：去掉第二个任务，用更多数据训练更久，它就能比得上之后发表的所有模型。<bookmark mark='d'/>ELECTRA让一个小网络替换词，训练主网络去找出被替换的词，于是它从每个位置学习，而不是只从15%的位置学习。<bookmark mark='e'/>编码器统治了语言理解两年，而且从未离开：搜索和检索背后的嵌入模型，大多是编码器。

05957786f77c.en: Chapter four. Everything is text to text.
05957786f77c.zh: 第4章。一切都是文本到文本。

1c84d6e95e3f.en: In October 2019, Colin Raffel and colleagues at Google asked a plain question. With so many objectives and architectures on offer, which actually work best? To compare them fairly, they first made every task the same shape. <bookmark mark='a'/> Text in, text out. Translation: the words 'translate English to German', then the sentence, and the model writes the German. <bookmark mark='b'/> Grammar: the model writes 'acceptable' or 'not acceptable'. Even a similarity score is written out as text: three point eight. <bookmark mark='c'/> And summaries. One model, one loss, one way of decoding, for every task. They called it T5, the Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer, and trained it on C4, a cleaned crawl of the web of about 750 gigabytes.
1c84d6e95e3f.zh: 2019年10月，谷歌的科林·拉费尔和同事问了一个朴素的问题。有这么多目标函数和架构可选，到底哪些最好用？为了公平比较，他们先把每个任务都变成同一个形状。<bookmark mark='a'/>文本进，文本出。翻译：先写translate English to German，再写句子，模型就写出德语。<bookmark mark='b'/>语法判断：模型写出acceptable或者not acceptable。连相似度分数也写成文本：3.8。<bookmark mark='c'/>还有摘要。一个模型，一个损失，一种解码方式，适用于每个任务。他们叫它T5，文本到文本迁移Transformer，并在C4上训练它，那是一个清洗过的网页抓取数据集，大约750GB。

d2b5fa818777.en: Their pretraining objective, the one that won their comparison, is a cousin of BERT's masking, called span corruption. <bookmark mark='a'/> Pick fifteen percent of the tokens, in spans averaging three tokens. <bookmark mark='b'/> Replace each span with one sentinel token in the input. <bookmark mark='c'/> The target is just the missing spans, each after its sentinel. The encoder reads the damaged text both ways; the decoder writes what was taken out.
d2b5fa818777.zh: 他们的预训练目标，也就是在比较中胜出的那个，是BERT掩码的近亲，叫作片段破坏。<bookmark mark='a'/>挑出15%的词元，组成平均长度为3的片段。<bookmark mark='b'/>在输入里，每个片段换成一个哨兵词元。<bookmark mark='c'/>目标就是缺失的那些片段，每个跟在它的哨兵后面。编码器双向读取被破坏的文本；解码器写出被拿走的部分。

8e5316d78d81.en: Then came the comparison, with every model given the same budget of compute. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here are the architectures and objectives, each pretrained, then fine-tuned and scored on three benchmarks: GLUE, question answering, and SuperGLUE. <bookmark mark='b'/> The encoder–decoder trained by denoising came first, with 83.3 on GLUE. <bookmark mark='c'/> The decoder-only language model, trained to predict the next token, the GPT recipe, came last: 73.8, about 10 points behind. On tasks fine-tuned for understanding, seeing both ways won again.
8e5316d78d81.zh: 接下来是比较，每个模型都给同样的算力预算。<bookmark mark='a'/>这里是各种架构和目标，每个都先预训练，再微调，在三个基准上评分：GLUE、问答和SuperGLUE。<bookmark mark='b'/>用去噪训练的编码器-解码器排第一，GLUE得83.3分。<bookmark mark='c'/>只有解码器、训练来预测下一个词元的语言模型，也就是GPT的配方，排在最后：73.8分，落后大约10分。在为理解而微调的任务上，双向看又一次赢了。

d71a0407ab04.en: The largest T5, eleven billion parameters, came within a point of the human score on SuperGLUE. And yet the decoder-only design is the one that took over. Why? <bookmark mark='a'/> A 2022 study by Thomas Wang and colleagues, in the BigScience collaboration, gives the clearest answer. They trained five-billion-parameter models on 170 billion tokens with each architecture and objective. <bookmark mark='b'/> Judged after fine-tuning on many tasks, the models that see both ways, with masked objectives, were best, just as T5 found. <bookmark mark='c'/> But judged with no fine-tuning at all, simply prompting the pretrained model, the causal decoder trained on the next token was best. <bookmark mark='d'/> And the field was about to stop fine-tuning a separate model for every task, and start asking one model, in words. That shift began with GPT-2.
d71a0407ab04.zh: 最大的T5有110亿个参数，在SuperGLUE上离人类分数不到一分。然而，接管一切的却是只有解码器的设计。为什么？<bookmark mark='a'/>2022年，托马斯·王和同事在BigScience合作中做的一项研究，给出了最清楚的答案。他们用每种架构和目标，在1700亿个词元上训练了50亿参数的模型。<bookmark mark='b'/>如果在许多任务上微调之后再评判，能双向看、用掩码目标的模型最好，正如T5发现的那样。<bookmark mark='c'/>但如果完全不微调，只是对预训练模型给出提示，那么训练来预测下一个词元的因果解码器最好。<bookmark mark='d'/>而这个领域即将不再为每个任务微调一个单独的模型，而是开始用语言去问同一个模型。这个转变从GPT-2开始。

94660c24ab3f.en: Chapter five. Language models are unsupervised multitask learners.
94660c24ab3f.zh: 第5章。语言模型是无监督的多任务学习者。

b76c3f7e980a.en: February 2019. Alec Radford, Jeffrey Wu, Rewon Child, David Luan, Dario Amodei and Ilya Sutskever, at OpenAI. Their bet: a big enough language model, trained on varied enough text, would learn tasks without being told, because the web is full of tasks being done. <bookmark mark='a'/> To get varied text of decent quality, they took every outbound link from Reddit that had earned at least three karma, about forty-five million links. After cleaning and removing duplicates: eight million documents, forty gigabytes of text. <bookmark mark='b'/> The model was GPT-1, scaled up, with layer normalization moved to the input of each block and a context of 1,024 tokens. Four sizes, the largest forty-eight layers deep and 1,600 wide: one and a half billion parameters.
b76c3f7e980a.zh: 2019年2月。OpenAI的亚历克·拉德福德、杰弗里·吴、雷文·蔡尔德、大卫·栾、达里奥·阿莫代和伊利亚·苏茨克维。他们押的赌注是：一个足够大的语言模型，在足够多样的文本上训练，不用告诉它，也能学会任务，因为网上到处都是人们在完成任务的文字。<bookmark mark='a'/>为了得到质量还不错的多样文本，他们取了Reddit上每一个至少得到3个karma的外链，大约4500万个链接。清洗和去重之后：800万篇文档，40GB的文本。<bookmark mark='b'/>模型就是放大了的GPT-1，把层归一化挪到了每个模块的输入处，上下文为1024个词元。四种大小，最大的48层深、1600宽：15亿个参数。

c64c7498125d.en: The idea is that a task is just text with a pattern, and a good enough predictor will continue the pattern. <bookmark mark='a'/> To summarize an article, put 'TL;DR:' after it, the way people on the internet do, and let the model write. <bookmark mark='b'/> To translate, show a few lines of the form 'english sentence equals french sentence', then an English sentence and an equals sign. <bookmark mark='c'/> To answer questions about a passage, write the passage, the conversation so far, and 'A:'. <bookmark mark='d'/> Nothing is fine-tuned; the task lives in the prompt. On a reading comprehension test, that got 55 F1, matching three of four systems trained on more than a hundred thousand human answers.
c64c7498125d.zh: 想法是，一个任务只是带有某种模式的文本，一个足够好的预测器会把模式延续下去。<bookmark mark='a'/>要总结一篇文章，就在后面加上TL;DR，网上的人就是这么写的，然后让模型接着写。<bookmark mark='b'/>要翻译，就先给几行“英语句子等于法语句子”的形式，再给一个英语句子和一个等号。<bookmark mark='c'/>要回答关于一段文字的问题，就写出这段文字、目前为止的对话，再写上A和冒号。<bookmark mark='d'/>什么都不用微调；任务就在提示里。在一个阅读理解测试上，这样得到了55的F1分，与四个系统中的三个持平，而那些系统是用十多万个人工答案训练的。

36fedf2a435a.en: With no task-specific training at all, the largest model set records on seven of eight language-modelling benchmarks. <bookmark mark='a'/> The cleanest picture is LAMBADA, where the last word of a passage can only be guessed from the whole passage. Accuracy climbs with size: 46, 55, 60, 63 percent, <bookmark mark='b'/> the last above the previous best of 59, set by models built for this test. <bookmark mark='c'/> On Wikipedia, character by character, it reached 0.93 bits per byte, a number from the family of our scoreboard. Its translations were still poor. But almost everything improved steadily with size, and that trend was the real result.
36fedf2a435a.zh: 完全不针对任务训练，最大的模型就在八个语言建模基准中的七个上创了纪录。<bookmark mark='a'/>最清楚的是LAMBADA：一段话的最后一个词，只有看完整段话才能猜出来。准确率随着规模上升：46%、55%、60%、63%，<bookmark mark='b'/>最后一个超过了之前专门为这个测试打造的模型的最好成绩59%。<bookmark mark='c'/>在维基百科上逐字符预测，它达到了每字节0.93比特，这个数和我们记分牌上的数是一家。它的翻译还很差。但几乎所有东西都随规模稳步提升，这个趋势才是真正的结果。

3f9cdb9a5b70.en: OpenAI did not release the largest model at first. Citing the risk of misuse, such as fake news written at scale, it published the smallest version in February, <bookmark mark='a'/> larger ones in May and August, and the full one and a half billion parameters in November 2019, <bookmark mark='b'/> with a model card describing what it was for, where it failed, and the biases of its training text. The debate it started, about when to release a model's weights, has never stopped; Part 31 returns to it. <bookmark mark='c'/> The paper's lasting lesson was simpler: one model, trained only to predict text, can be pointed at many tasks. The obvious next step was to make it much bigger.
3f9cdb9a5b70.zh: OpenAI起初没有发布最大的模型。理由是可能被滥用，比如大规模地编写假新闻。它在2月发布了最小的版本，<bookmark mark='a'/>5月和8月发布了更大的版本，2019年11月发布了完整的15亿参数模型，<bookmark mark='b'/>还附带一份模型卡，说明它的用途、它会在哪里失败，以及训练文本中的偏见。它引发的争论，关于什么时候该发布模型权重，至今没有停止；第31部分会再谈。<bookmark mark='c'/>这篇论文留下的教训更简单：一个只被训练来预测文本的模型，可以被指向许多任务。显而易见的下一步，就是把它做得大得多。

6a2851902cbd.en: Chapter six. Scale, and learning in context.
6a2851902cbd.zh: 第6章。规模，以及在上下文中学习。

69b2915415dc.en: January 2020. Jared Kaplan, Sam McCandlish and colleagues at OpenAI measured how a language model's loss falls as it grows. <bookmark mark='a'/> Across more than seven orders of magnitude, the test loss followed a power law in the number of parameters, with a small exponent, about 0.076, and similar laws in the data and the compute. <bookmark mark='b'/> The message: bigger models get more out of every token, and for a fixed budget you should grow the model faster than the data. Part 12 derived these laws, and the correction that came two years later. In 2020 they were the case for building something enormous.
69b2915415dc.zh: 2020年1月。OpenAI的贾里德·卡普兰、萨姆·麦坎德利什和同事，测量了语言模型的损失怎样随着规模下降。<bookmark mark='a'/>在超过七个数量级的范围里，测试损失随参数数量呈幂律，指数很小，大约0.076；数据和算力也有类似的规律。<bookmark mark='b'/>它传递的信息是：更大的模型能从每个词元中得到更多；预算固定时，模型应该比数据长得更快。第12部分推导了这些定律，以及两年后的修正。在2020年，它们是造一个庞然大物的理由。

1513bb7e8206.en: May 2020. Tom Brown and thirty colleagues at OpenAI: GPT-3. Eight sizes, from 125 million to 175 billion parameters, all trained on 300 billion tokens. The largest has 96 layers, a width of 12,288, 96 heads, and a context of 2,048 tokens. Where do 175 billion parameters come from? <bookmark mark='a'/> Each layer has four attention matrices, for queries, keys, values and the output, each d by d. <bookmark mark='b'/> The feed-forward network has two matrices of d by four d: eight d squared. <bookmark mark='c'/> So a layer holds twelve d squared, and the embeddings add the vocabulary and the positions times d. <bookmark mark='d'/> For GPT-3 that's 173.9 billion in the layers and 0.64 billion in the embeddings, <bookmark mark='e'/> 174.6 billion in all, exactly the figure in the paper's appendix. The training mix leaned toward quality: filtered web pages were most of it, but the smaller, cleaner sources were seen two or three times over.
1513bb7e8206.zh: 2020年5月。OpenAI的汤姆·布朗和三十位同事：GPT-3。八种大小，从1.25亿到1750亿个参数，全都用3000亿个词元训练。最大的有96层，宽度12288，96个头，上下文2048个词元。1750亿个参数是怎么来的？<bookmark mark='a'/>每层有四个注意力矩阵，分别用于查询、键、值和输出，每个都是d乘d。<bookmark mark='b'/>前馈网络有两个d乘4d的矩阵：8个d的平方。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以一层有12个d的平方，嵌入再加上词表大小和位置数乘以d。<bookmark mark='d'/>对GPT-3来说，层里大约是1739亿，嵌入里是6.4亿，<bookmark mark='e'/>合计1746亿，与论文附录里的数字完全一致。训练数据偏重质量：过滤后的网页占了大部分，但更小、更干净的来源被看了两三遍。

878e674e222b.en: Now the compute, counted a second way. <bookmark mark='a'/> Training on one token costs about six operations per parameter: two in the forward pass, a multiply and an add, and about four in the backward pass, because the gradient is needed both for the weights and for the layer below. So C is about six N D. <bookmark mark='b'/> Six, times 174.6 billion parameters, times 300 billion tokens, <bookmark mark='c'/> is 3.14 times ten to the twenty-three operations, the paper's own figure. <bookmark mark='d'/> In the paper's unit, 3,637 petaflop-days: a computer doing a thousand trillion operations a second, for about 10 years. That is about 14,000 times the compute of chapter one's Transformer.
878e674e222b.zh: 现在用第二种方法来数算力。<bookmark mark='a'/>在一个词元上训练，每个参数大约要6次运算：前向传播2次，一次乘法一次加法；反向传播大约4次，因为既要算权重的梯度，也要算传给下一层的梯度。所以C约等于6ND。<bookmark mark='b'/>6，乘以1746亿个参数，乘以3000亿个词元，<bookmark mark='c'/>等于3.14乘以10的23次方次运算，正是论文自己给出的数字。<bookmark mark='d'/>用论文的单位，是3637个petaflop/s-天：一台每秒运算一千万亿次的计算机，要算大约10年。这大约是第1章那个Transformer所用算力的14000倍。

9082fb11756c.en: But GPT-3 is remembered for something else, the thing its title promised: language models are few-shot learners. <bookmark mark='a'/> In-context learning: put a description of the task, and perhaps a few examples, in the prompt, and let the model continue. No gradient step is taken; not one weight changes. <bookmark mark='b'/> Here is the paper's own illustration: translate English to French; sea otter, loutre de mer; peppermint, menthe poivrée; and then cheese, and an arrow. <bookmark mark='c'/> With only the description, it's called zero-shot; with one example, one-shot; with as many as fit in the context, typically ten to a hundred, few-shot.
9082fb11756c.zh: 但GPT-3让人记住的是另一件事，也就是它标题里承诺的：语言模型是少样本学习者。<bookmark mark='a'/>上下文学习：把任务的描述，也许再加几个例子，放进提示里，让模型接着写。不做任何梯度更新；没有一个权重改变。<bookmark mark='b'/>这是论文自己的示例：把英语翻译成法语；sea otter，loutre de mer；peppermint，menthe poivrée；然后是cheese，和一个箭头。<bookmark mark='c'/>只有描述，叫作零样本；有一个例子，叫单样本；有上下文能装下的那么多例子，通常十到一百个，叫少样本。

d27b7b165308.en: And it worked. <bookmark mark='a'/> On LAMBADA, GPT-3 reached 76.2 percent zero-shot and 86.4 percent few-shot, against a previous best of 68. <bookmark mark='b'/> Answering trivia questions from memory, with no documents to look in: 64.3 percent zero-shot, 68 one-shot, 71.2 few-shot. <bookmark mark='c'/> And across the eight sizes, the gap between zero-shot and few-shot widened: larger models made better use of what was in their context. Nobody had trained for this. It appeared with scale. In chapter fourteen we'll look for it in our own small models.
d27b7b165308.zh: 而且它奏效了。<bookmark mark='a'/>在LAMBADA上，GPT-3零样本达到76.2%，少样本达到86.4%，之前的最好成绩是68%。<bookmark mark='b'/>不查任何文档、凭记忆回答常识问答题：零样本64.3%，单样本68%，少样本71.2%。<bookmark mark='c'/>而在八种大小之间，零样本和少样本的差距越来越大：更大的模型能更好地利用上下文里的东西。没有人专门为此训练过。它是随着规模出现的。在第14章，我们会在自己的小模型里寻找它。

fc5de868ce62.en: Chapter seven. Code, and following instructions.
fc5de868ce62.zh: 第7章。代码，以及遵循指令。

73e0ab9429dd.en: July 2021. Mark Chen and colleagues at OpenAI fine-tuned GPT models on code: 159 gigabytes of Python, from 54 million public GitHub repositories. The result, Codex, powered the first GitHub Copilot. <bookmark mark='a'/> To measure it, they wrote HumanEval: 164 programming problems, each a function signature and a description, checked by hidden unit tests. A program counts only if it passes. <bookmark mark='b'/> GPT-3 solved none of them. GPT-J, an open model of six billion parameters, 11.4 percent. <bookmark mark='c'/> Codex, with twelve billion parameters, solved 28.8 percent on its first try, <bookmark mark='d'/> and 70.2 percent when it could write a hundred programs and the tests picked any that worked. Sampling many answers and checking them comes back, as a way of thinking, in Part 28.
73e0ab9429dd.zh: 2021年7月。OpenAI的马克·陈和同事用代码微调GPT模型：159GB的Python代码，来自5400万个公开的GitHub仓库。结果就是Codex，它驱动了第一版GitHub Copilot。<bookmark mark='a'/>为了衡量它，他们编写了HumanEval：164道编程题，每道是一个函数签名加一段描述，用隐藏的单元测试来检查。程序只有通过测试才算对。<bookmark mark='b'/>GPT-3一道也没做出来。GPT-J，一个60亿参数的开放模型，做出了11.4%。<bookmark mark='c'/>120亿参数的Codex，第一次尝试就做出了28.8%，<bookmark mark='d'/>如果允许它写一百个程序、由测试挑出任何一个能通过的，就是70.2%。生成许多答案再加以检验，这个想法会在第28部分作为一种思考方式再次出现。

483cab390a02.en: Meanwhile, two groups asked whether a model could learn to follow instructions in general. <bookmark mark='a'/> In September 2021, Jason Wei and colleagues at Google took a language model of 137 billion parameters and fine-tuned it on more than sixty existing datasets, each rewritten as instructions in plain English. <bookmark mark='b'/> To test it fairly, they grouped tasks by type and held out a whole type at a time: a model tested on inference had never been tuned on any inference task. <bookmark mark='c'/> Their model, FLAN, beat zero-shot GPT-3 on twenty of twenty-five datasets. <bookmark mark='d'/> A month later Victor Sanh and a large BigScience team did the same with T5. Their T0, eleven billion parameters, matched or beat GPT-3 on nine of eleven held-out datasets, while sixteen times smaller. <bookmark mark='e'/> Instruction tuning teaches the form of being asked, and the form carries over to tasks the model has never seen.
483cab390a02.zh: 与此同时，两个团队在问：能不能让模型学会遵循一般的指令？<bookmark mark='a'/>2021年9月，谷歌的杰森·魏和同事，拿一个1370亿参数的语言模型，在六十多个现有数据集上微调，每个数据集都改写成简单英语的指令。<bookmark mark='b'/>为了公平测试，他们按类型给任务分组，每次留出一整类：在推理上测试的模型，从没在任何推理任务上调过。<bookmark mark='c'/>他们的模型FLAN，在25个数据集中的20个上超过了零样本的GPT-3。<bookmark mark='d'/>一个月后，维克多·桑和一个庞大的BigScience团队用T5做了同样的事。他们的T0有110亿个参数，在11个留出的数据集中的9个上追平或超过GPT-3，而模型小了16倍。<bookmark mark='e'/>指令微调教会的是“被提问”的形式，而这种形式能迁移到模型从没见过的任务上。

32c3b386d87f.en: Instruction tuning used existing datasets. OpenAI's InstructGPT, published in March 2022, used people. <bookmark mark='a'/> Labellers wrote good answers to about thirteen thousand prompts, and GPT-3 was fine-tuned to imitate them. <bookmark mark='b'/> They ranked the model's answers to thirty-three thousand prompts, and a reward model learned their preferences. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then reinforcement learning pushed the model toward answers the reward model liked, on thirty-one thousand more prompts. <bookmark mark='d'/> People preferred the answers of the 1.3-billion-parameter InstructGPT to those of the 175-billion-parameter GPT-3. Every one of these stages is built, on our own model, in Part 27.
32c3b386d87f.zh: 指令微调用的是现有数据集。OpenAI在2022年3月发表的InstructGPT，用的是人。<bookmark mark='a'/>标注员为大约13000个提示写了好答案，GPT-3被微调去模仿它们。<bookmark mark='b'/>他们给模型对33000个提示的回答排序，一个奖励模型学习他们的偏好。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后，强化学习在另外31000个提示上，把模型推向奖励模型喜欢的回答。<bookmark mark='d'/>人们更喜欢13亿参数的InstructGPT的回答，胜过1750亿参数的GPT-3。这些阶段的每一个，都会在第27部分用我们自己的模型搭建出来。

19d54ad74b80.en: Chapter eight. ChatGPT, and the closed era.

f7533f816a1a.en: On the thirtieth of November 2022, OpenAI put a model trained with InstructGPT's recipe, tuned for conversation, behind a free chat window, and called it ChatGPT. <bookmark mark='a'/> Nothing inside it was new to researchers: a GPT-3.5 model, supervised fine-tuning, a reward model, PPO. What was new was that anyone could try it. <bookmark mark='b'/> By one estimate it had a hundred million monthly users two months later, faster than any consumer app before it. <bookmark mark='c'/> It turned language models from a research topic into an industry, and it changed what the field optimized: not benchmark scores after fine-tuning, but how useful one model is when people simply talk to it.
f7533f816a1a.zh: 2022年11月30日，OpenAI把一个用InstructGPT的配方训练、为对话调过的模型，放到一个免费的聊天窗口后面，取名ChatGPT。<bookmark mark='a'/>对研究者来说，里面没有什么新东西：一个GPT-3.5模型，监督微调，一个奖励模型，PPO。新的是，任何人都能试一试。<bookmark mark='b'/>据一项估计，两个月后它就有了一亿月活跃用户，比之前任何一款消费应用都快。<bookmark mark='c'/>它把语言模型从一个研究课题变成了一个产业，也改变了这个领域优化的目标：不再是微调后的基准分数，而是人们直接和一个模型说话时，它有多有用。

cfffe60ddf37.en: On the fourteenth of March 2023 came GPT-4. It accepted images as well as text. <bookmark mark='a'/> On a simulated bar exam, it scored around the top ten percent of test takers, where GPT-3.5 had scored around the bottom ten. <bookmark mark='b'/> On MMLU, multiple-choice questions in fifty-seven subjects, 86.4 percent, against 70. <bookmark mark='c'/> And the report made a claim about method: OpenAI fitted scaling laws to small training runs, using at most ten thousand times less compute, and predicted GPT-4's final loss before the big run was finished. Scaling had become engineering.
cfffe60ddf37.zh: 2023年3月14日，GPT-4来了。它除了文字，也接受图像。<bookmark mark='a'/>在模拟的律师资格考试中，它的成绩大约在考生的前10%，而GPT-3.5大约在后10%。<bookmark mark='b'/>在MMLU，一个涵盖57个学科的选择题测试上，它得到86.4%，GPT-3.5是70%。<bookmark mark='c'/>报告还提出了一个关于方法的说法：OpenAI用小规模的训练运行拟合规模定律，所用算力最多少一万倍，在大规模训练完成之前，就预测出了GPT-4的最终损失。规模，已经变成了工程。

f6eebcf4c0d1.en: And the report left something out, on purpose. In its own words: <bookmark mark='a'/> given both the competitive landscape and the safety implications of large-scale models like GPT-4, the report contains no further details about the architecture, including model size, hardware, training compute, dataset construction, training method, or similar. <bookmark mark='b'/> No size, no data, no compute. Outside estimates, from Epoch AI, put the compute at about two times ten to the twenty-five operations, and the hardware and energy of the final run at about forty million dollars. <bookmark mark='c'/> What it did publish was a system card: the model's risks, with examples, the testing by more than fifty outside experts, and the mitigations applied before release. System cards became standard for every frontier release after it.
f6eebcf4c0d1.zh: 报告也有意地略去了一些东西。用它自己的话说：<bookmark mark='a'/>考虑到竞争格局，以及像GPT-4这样的大规模模型的安全影响，本报告不包含关于架构的更多细节，包括模型大小、硬件、训练算力、数据集构建、训练方法，或类似内容。<bookmark mark='b'/>没有大小，没有数据，没有算力。外部的估计来自Epoch AI：算力大约是2乘以10的25次方次运算，最后一次训练的硬件和能耗大约四千万美元。<bookmark mark='c'/>它确实发布的，是一份系统卡：模型的风险，附有例子；五十多位外部专家的测试；以及发布前采取的缓解措施。此后每一次前沿发布，系统卡都成了标配。

28b6197f4d67.en: For the next two years the frontier was closed. <bookmark mark='a'/> Anthropic released Claude the same week as GPT-4. <bookmark mark='b'/> Google's Gemini followed in December, built to take images, audio and video from the start. <bookmark mark='c'/> And in September 2024, OpenAI's o1 showed that a model trained with reinforcement learning to think at length before answering could do far better at mathematics and code: the reasoning models of Part 28. <bookmark mark='d'/> Their weights, data and sizes stayed private. If we want to read real configurations, year by year, we have to look at the models whose weights were released. That story starts in February 2023.
28b6197f4d67.zh: 接下来的两年里，前沿是闭源的。<bookmark mark='a'/>Anthropic在GPT-4的同一周发布了Claude。<bookmark mark='b'/>谷歌的Gemini在12月跟进，从一开始就设计为接受图像、音频和视频。<bookmark mark='c'/>而在2024年9月，OpenAI的o1表明，一个用强化学习训练、在回答之前先长时间思考的模型，在数学和代码上能好得多：这就是第28部分的推理模型。<bookmark mark='d'/>它们的权重、数据和大小都没有公开。如果我们想逐年读到真实的配置，就得去看那些公开了权重的模型。这个故事从2023年2月开始。

b52c053fd4f3.en: February 2023. Hugo Touvron and colleagues at Meta released LLaMA: four models, from seven to sixty-five billion parameters, trained only on publicly available data, one to one point four trillion tokens. <bookmark mark='a'/> The headline result: LLaMA-13B outperformed the 175-billion-parameter GPT-3 on most benchmarks, at more than thirteen times smaller. <bookmark mark='b'/> The weights went to researchers, and a whole open ecosystem was built on them within weeks: Stanford's Alpaca, Vicuna, and many more, fine-tuned on single machines.
b52c053fd4f3.zh: 2023年2月。Meta的雨果·图夫龙和同事发布了LLaMA：四个模型，从70亿到650亿个参数，只用公开可得的数据训练，1万亿到1.4万亿个词元。<bookmark mark='a'/>最引人注目的结果是：LLaMA-13B在大多数基准上超过了1750亿参数的GPT-3，而它小了十三倍多。<bookmark mark='b'/>权重提供给了研究者，几周之内，一整个开放生态就建在了它们之上：斯坦福的Alpaca、Vicuna，还有更多，都是在单台机器上微调出来的。

c7ff37162ad6.en: How could a 13-billion-parameter model beat GPT-3? By reading far more text per parameter. <bookmark mark='a'/> GPT-3 saw about 1.7 tokens for each of its parameters. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 2022, DeepMind's Chinchilla paper had shown that for a fixed training budget, the best model sees about twenty tokens per parameter: GPT-3 was far too big for its data. <bookmark mark='c'/> LLaMA went past even that. Its 7-billion-parameter model saw about 149 tokens per parameter. <bookmark mark='d'/> That is more training than compute-optimal: you could have trained a better model with the same budget. But a smaller model is cheaper to run, for every token it ever serves, and once millions of people use a model, running it costs far more than training it. Part 12 derives the trade.
c7ff37162ad6.zh: 一个130亿参数的模型，怎么能打败GPT-3？靠的是每个参数读更多的文本。<bookmark mark='a'/>GPT-3每个参数大约只看了1.7个词元。<bookmark mark='b'/>2022年，DeepMind的Chinchilla论文表明，预算固定时，最好的模型每个参数大约要看20个词元：GPT-3相对于它的数据实在太大了。<bookmark mark='c'/>LLaMA走得更远。它的70亿参数模型，每个参数大约看了150个词元。<bookmark mark='d'/>这比计算最优的训练量还多：用同样的预算，本可以训练出一个更好的模型。但更小的模型运行起来更便宜，它服务的每一个词元都便宜；而一旦有上百万人在用一个模型，运行它的花费就远远超过训练它的花费。第12部分推导了这个取舍。

b4575019ef79.en: Then came a wave. <bookmark mark='a'/> In July 2023, Llama 2: two trillion tokens, forty percent more, twice the context, chat versions tuned with RLHF, and a license that allowed commercial use. <bookmark mark='b'/> In September, Mistral 7B, from a young company in Paris, under the Apache license. It beat Llama 2's 13-billion-parameter model, with grouped-query attention and a sliding window, both explained in the next chapter. <bookmark mark='c'/> In December, Mixtral: every layer has eight feed-forward experts, and a router picks two for each token, so the model holds forty-seven billion parameters but uses thirteen billion per token. It matched or beat Llama 2 70B and GPT-3.5. Mixtures of experts are Part 16. <bookmark mark='d'/> And in July 2024, Meta's Llama 3.1: 405 billion parameters, 15.6 trillion tokens, 3.8 times ten to the twenty-five operations, on up to sixteen thousand GPUs. <bookmark mark='e'/> Its report even counted the failures: 466 interruptions in fifty-four days. Frontier-scale training, documented in public.
b4575019ef79.zh: 接着来了一波浪潮。<bookmark mark='a'/>2023年7月，Llama 2：2万亿个词元，多了40%，上下文翻倍，有用RLHF调过的聊天版本，许可证允许商用。<bookmark mark='b'/>9月，巴黎一家年轻的公司推出Mistral 7B，采用Apache许可证。它打败了Llama 2的130亿参数模型，用的是分组查询注意力和滑动窗口，下一章会讲这两样。<bookmark mark='c'/>12月，Mixtral：每一层有八个前馈专家，一个路由器为每个词元挑两个，所以模型有470亿个参数，但每个词元只用130亿。它追平或超过了Llama 2 70B和GPT-3.5。混合专家是第16部分的内容。<bookmark mark='d'/>2024年7月，Meta的Llama 3.1：4050亿个参数，15.6万亿个词元，3.8乘以10的25次方次运算，最多用了一万六千块GPU。<bookmark mark='e'/>它的报告甚至统计了故障：54天里中断了466次。前沿规模的训练，被公开地记录了下来。

b3cf3bd9f798.en: And from China came open models that would soon lead. <bookmark mark='a'/> Alibaba's Qwen family began in 2023; by late 2024 Qwen2.5 was trained on eighteen trillion tokens, in sizes from tiny to large. <bookmark mark='b'/> DeepSeek's V2, in May 2024, had 236 billion parameters but used only 21 billion for each token, and a new kind of attention, multi-head latent attention, that cut the memory kept for past tokens by 93 percent. <bookmark mark='c'/> By 2025, the strongest open models came from Chinese labs: DeepSeek, Qwen, Moonshot's Kimi and Zhipu's GLM. <bookmark mark='d'/> Open weights mean open configurations. In the next chapter we read them side by side.
b3cf3bd9f798.zh: 而来自中国的开放模型，很快就走到了前面。<bookmark mark='a'/>阿里巴巴的通义千问Qwen系列始于2023年；到2024年底，Qwen2.5已经用18万亿个词元训练，大小从很小到很大都有。<bookmark mark='b'/>2024年5月，深度求索的DeepSeek-V2有2360亿个参数，但每个词元只用210亿，还用了一种新的注意力，多头潜在注意力，把为过去的词元保留的内存减少了93%。<bookmark mark='c'/>到2025年，最强的开放模型来自中国的实验室：DeepSeek、Qwen、月之暗面的Kimi和智谱的GLM。<bookmark mark='d'/>开放权重意味着开放配置。下一章，我们把它们并排来读。

877d6afea45a.en: Open weights mean open configurations, so we can watch the designs change year by year. Here is one card, and how it changed. <bookmark mark='a'/> The 2017 Transformer. <bookmark mark='b'/> GPT-2, 2019: forty-eight layers. <bookmark mark='c'/> GPT-3, 2020: ninety-six layers, twelve thousand wide. <bookmark mark='d'/> LLaMA, 2023: smaller, but trained on 1.4 trillion tokens. <bookmark mark='e'/> Llama 3.1, 2024: 126 layers, 16,384 wide, a context of 128 thousand tokens. <bookmark mark='f'/> DeepSeek-V3: fewer layers, but 671 billion parameters, only 37 billion of them used for each token. <bookmark mark='g'/> Qwen3, 2025: 36 trillion tokens. <bookmark mark='h'/> And Kimi K3, 2026: 2.8 trillion parameters and a context of a million tokens, 2,048 times GPT-1's.
877d6afea45a.zh: 开放权重意味着开放配置，所以我们能看着设计逐年变化。这里是一张卡片，以及它怎样变化。<bookmark mark='a'/>2017年的Transformer。<bookmark mark='b'/>GPT-2，2019年：48层。<bookmark mark='c'/>GPT-3，2020年：96层，一万两千多宽。<bookmark mark='d'/>LLaMA，2023年：更小了，但用1.4万亿个词元训练。<bookmark mark='e'/>Llama 3.1，2024年：126层，16384宽，上下文12.8万个词元。<bookmark mark='f'/>DeepSeek-V3：层数更少，但有6710亿个参数，每个词元只用其中的370亿。<bookmark mark='g'/>Qwen3，2025年：36万亿个词元。<bookmark mark='h'/>还有Kimi K3，2026年：2.8万亿个参数，上下文一百万个词元，是GPT-1的2048倍。

d0fa99428c9d.en: Now read the recipes side by side, across five design choices. <bookmark mark='a'/> The 2017 Transformer: layer normalization after each sub-layer, ReLU, sine-wave positions, ordinary multi-head attention, biases everywhere. <bookmark mark='b'/> GPT-2 and GPT-3 moved the normalization before each sub-layer; T5 dropped its mean and bias. <bookmark mark='c'/> PaLM, in 2022: SwiGLU, rotary positions, a single shared key and value, no biases. <bookmark mark='d'/> LLaMA put the pieces together, and from Llama 2's largest model on, nearly every open model looks the same: pre-norm RMSNorm, SwiGLU, rotary positions, grouped-query attention, no biases. <bookmark mark='e'/> Then DeepSeek-V3 changed the attention, Qwen3 added a normalization inside it, and the convergence began to loosen: the next chapter. First, why each choice won.
d0fa99428c9d.zh: 现在把各家的配方并排来读，看五个设计选择。<bookmark mark='a'/>2017年的Transformer：在每个子层之后做层归一化，ReLU，正弦波位置编码，普通的多头注意力，到处都有偏置。<bookmark mark='b'/>GPT-2和GPT-3把归一化挪到了每个子层之前；T5去掉了它的均值和偏置。<bookmark mark='c'/>2022年的PaLM：SwiGLU，旋转位置编码，所有头共用一组键和值，没有偏置。<bookmark mark='d'/>LLaMA把这些拼在了一起，而从Llama 2最大的模型开始，几乎每个开放模型看起来都一样：前置归一化的RMSNorm，SwiGLU，旋转位置编码，分组查询注意力，没有偏置。<bookmark mark='e'/>后来DeepSeek-V3换掉了注意力，Qwen3在注意力里面加了归一化，趋同开始松动：那是下一章的内容。先看看每个选择为什么胜出。

cc22d4be8d39.en: Normalization first. <bookmark mark='a'/> The 2017 Transformer normalized after adding each sub-layer's output to the stream. <bookmark mark='b'/> Pre-norm normalizes only the input of the branch, and adds the branch's output back untouched. <bookmark mark='c'/> Unroll that, and the stream at the top is the stream at layer l plus the sum of every layer's contribution above it. <bookmark mark='d'/> So its derivative contains the identity: the gradient reaches every layer directly, however deep the stack. Ruibin Xiong and colleagues showed in 2020 that pre-norm Transformers train without the long warm-up post-norm needs. <bookmark mark='e'/> And RMSNorm, from Biao Zhang and Rico Sennrich, drops the mean and the bias and just rescales by the root mean square: as good, and cheaper.
cc22d4be8d39.zh: 先说归一化。<bookmark mark='a'/>2017年的Transformer，在把每个子层的输出加回主干之后才做归一化。<bookmark mark='b'/>前置归一化只对分支的输入做归一化，再把分支的输出原封不动地加回去。<bookmark mark='c'/>把它展开，顶层的主干就等于第l层的主干，加上它上面每一层的贡献之和。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以它的导数里含有单位矩阵：无论堆得多深，梯度都能直接到达每一层。2020年，熊瑞斌和同事证明，前置归一化的Transformer不需要后置归一化那样漫长的预热就能训练。<bookmark mark='e'/>而张彪和里科·森里希提出的RMSNorm，去掉均值和偏置，只按均方根重新缩放：效果一样好，还更便宜。

262e8ddd8568.en: The feed-forward network. <bookmark mark='a'/> The original was two matrices with a ReLU between. <bookmark mark='b'/> SwiGLU, from Noam Shazeer in 2020, adds a third matrix as a gate: one branch, through the smooth Swish function, decides how much of the other branch passes, element by element. <bookmark mark='c'/> Three matrices instead of two, so to keep the parameter count, the hidden width shrinks to two thirds of four d. <bookmark mark='d'/> For LLaMA-65B, eight thirds of 8,192 is 21,845, rounded up to 22,016: exactly its published width. <bookmark mark='e'/> Why does gating help? It lowered the loss in Shazeer's experiments, and his paper's own answer is famous.
262e8ddd8568.zh: 再说前馈网络。<bookmark mark='a'/>原始的版本是两个矩阵，中间夹一个ReLU。<bookmark mark='b'/>2020年诺姆·沙泽尔提出的SwiGLU，加了第三个矩阵作为门控：一个分支经过平滑的Swish函数，逐个元素地决定另一个分支能通过多少。<bookmark mark='c'/>三个矩阵代替两个，为了保持参数量不变，隐藏层宽度缩小到4d的三分之二。<bookmark mark='d'/>对LLaMA-65B来说，8192的三分之八是21845，向上取整到22016：正好是它公布的宽度。<bookmark mark='e'/>门控为什么有用？在沙泽尔的实验里它降低了损失，而他论文里自己给的答案很有名。

10ef4b48e6e9.en: Positions and attention. Rotary embeddings won because a rotated query and key give a score that depends only on their distance, as Part 13 proved, and they stretch to longer contexts. <bookmark mark='g'/> Grouped-query attention won because of memory. <bookmark mark='a'/> To generate text, a model keeps the keys and values of every past token, in every layer: the KV cache. Per token, that's two, times the layers, times the key-value heads, times their size, times two bytes. <bookmark mark='b'/> GPT-3 kept about 4.7 megabytes per token. Llama 3.1, with all 128 heads keeping their own keys and values, would need 8.3. <bookmark mark='c'/> With grouped-query attention, the 128 query heads share just 8 key-value heads: 0.52 megabytes, sixteen times less. <bookmark mark='d'/> DeepSeek's latent attention compresses further, to about 70 kilobytes. <bookmark mark='e'/> At 128 thousand tokens of context, that's the difference between 1.1 terabytes and 68 gigabytes for a single conversation. Memory is the subject of Part 15.
10ef4b48e6e9.zh: 再说位置和注意力。旋转位置编码之所以胜出，是因为旋转过的查询和键得到的分数只取决于它们的距离，第13部分证明过这一点，而且它能延伸到更长的上下文。<bookmark mark='g'/>分组查询注意力之所以胜出，是因为内存。<bookmark mark='a'/>生成文本时，模型要在每一层保留每个过去词元的键和值：这就是KV缓存。每个词元占用的是：2，乘以层数，乘以键值头的数量，乘以头的大小，再乘以2个字节。<bookmark mark='b'/>GPT-3每个词元大约要4.7兆字节。Llama 3.1如果128个头都保留各自的键和值，就需要8.3兆字节。<bookmark mark='c'/>用分组查询注意力，128个查询头只共用8个键值头：0.52兆字节，少了16倍。<bookmark mark='d'/>DeepSeek的潜在注意力压缩得更多，大约70千字节。<bookmark mark='e'/>在12.8万个词元的上下文里，一次对话就是1.1太字节和68吉字节的差别。内存是第15部分的主题。

e09d6a340d70.en: Chapter eleven. The open frontier, 2024 to 2026.

64880d866027.en: December 2024: DeepSeek-V3. 671 billion parameters, 37 billion used per token. <bookmark mark='a'/> A mixture of 256 small experts plus one shared, eight chosen per token; latent attention; a way to keep the experts balanced without an extra loss; training to predict two tokens at a time; and training in eight-bit floating point, at this scale, for the first time. Fourteen point eight trillion tokens. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its report stated the cost: 2.788 million GPU-hours, about 5.6 million dollars at two dollars an hour, for the final run alone, not the research before it. <bookmark mark='c'/> A month later, DeepSeek-R1, trained from V3 with reinforcement learning on problems whose answers can be checked. Its pure-RL version went from 15.6 to 77.9 percent on the AIME 2024 mathematics competition during training. Open weights, under the MIT license; Part 28 explains how.
64880d866027.zh: 2024年12月：DeepSeek-V3。6710亿个参数，每个词元用370亿。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个由256个小专家外加1个共享专家组成的混合专家，每个词元选8个；潜在注意力；一种不需要额外损失就能让专家保持均衡的办法；训练时一次预测两个词元；而且第一次在这样的规模上用8位浮点数训练。14.8万亿个词元。<bookmark mark='b'/>它的报告写明了成本：278.8万个GPU小时，按每小时2美元算，大约560万美元，这只是最后一次训练，不包括之前的研究。<bookmark mark='c'/>一个月后是DeepSeek-R1，它从V3出发，用强化学习在答案可以核对的问题上训练。它的纯强化学习版本，在训练过程中，AIME 2024数学竞赛的成绩从15.6%升到77.9%。开放权重，MIT许可证；第28部分会讲它是怎么做到的。

d4bb973bd692.en: Through 2025 the open frontier filled in. <bookmark mark='a'/> Qwen3, in April: dense and mixture-of-experts models from 0.6 to 235 billion parameters, 36 trillion tokens, 119 languages, and thinking and non-thinking modes in one model. <bookmark mark='b'/> Kimi K2, from Moonshot AI in July: a trillion parameters, 32 billion active, trained on 15.5 trillion tokens with a new optimizer, MuonClip, without a single spike in the loss. <bookmark mark='c'/> GLM-4.5, from Zhipu, the same month. <bookmark mark='d'/> And in August, OpenAI's first open weights since GPT-2: gpt-oss, 117 billion parameters with 5.1 billion active, its weights in a four-bit format so that it fits on a single GPU, under the Apache license.
d4bb973bd692.zh: 2025年，开放前沿被逐渐填满。<bookmark mark='a'/>4月的Qwen3：稠密模型和混合专家模型，从6亿到2350亿个参数，36万亿个词元，119种语言，思考模式和非思考模式合在一个模型里。<bookmark mark='b'/>7月，月之暗面的Kimi K2：一万亿个参数，激活320亿，用一种新的优化器MuonClip在15.5万亿个词元上训练，损失曲线上一次尖峰都没有。<bookmark mark='c'/>同月还有智谱的GLM-4.5。<bookmark mark='d'/>8月，OpenAI自GPT-2以来第一次开放权重：gpt-oss，1170亿个参数，激活51亿，权重用4位格式存储，一块GPU就放得下，采用Apache许可证。

48ff656d9ba6.en: Put the models of this part on one chart: their total parameters against the parameters each token actually uses. <bookmark mark='a'/> Dense models sit on the diagonal: GPT-3, PaLM, LLaMA, Llama 3.1 use every parameter for every token. <bookmark mark='b'/> The open frontier moved below it. A mixture of experts routes each token through a few small networks out of hundreds, so capacity grows while the cost per token doesn't. <bookmark mark='c'/> Kimi K3 uses 104 billion of its 2.8 trillion: 3.7 percent. The frontier is sparse, and Part 16 is about how that works.
48ff656d9ba6.zh: 把本部分的模型放到一张图上：横轴是总参数，纵轴是每个词元实际用到的参数。<bookmark mark='a'/>稠密模型落在对角线上：GPT-3、PaLM、LLaMA、Llama 3.1对每个词元都用上每一个参数。<bookmark mark='b'/>开放前沿移到了对角线下方。混合专家让每个词元只经过几百个小网络中的几个，所以容量增长了，每个词元的成本却没有。<bookmark mark='c'/>Kimi K3在它的2.8万亿个参数里只用1040亿：3.7%。前沿是稀疏的，第16部分讲它怎样运作。

52037371f317.en: And the attention began to change. Its cost grows with the length of the context, and frontier models now read a million tokens. <bookmark mark='a'/> Hybrids replace most attention layers with layers whose memory stays a fixed size: AI21's Jamba in 2024; MiniMax-01 and NVIDIA's Nemotron-H in 2025; then Qwen3-Next and Moonshot's Kimi Linear, with three such layers for every attention layer. <bookmark mark='b'/> By 2026 the flagships were built this way, or with sparse attention. Qwen3.5, in February: a three-to-one hybrid. GLM-5, the same month: 744 billion parameters with DeepSeek's sparse attention. <bookmark mark='c'/> DeepSeek-V4, in April: 1.6 trillion parameters, compressed sparse attention, a million-token context. And Kimi K3, in July: 2.8 trillion parameters, sixty-nine layers of Kimi Delta Attention and twenty-four of latent attention. <bookmark mark='d'/> Parts 15 and 16 take these apart. The convergence of 2023 was real, but it was a pause: when contexts grew long and models grew sparse, the designs began to diverge again.
52037371f317.zh: 注意力也开始变了。它的成本随上下文长度增长，而前沿模型现在要读一百万个词元。<bookmark mark='a'/>混合架构把大部分注意力层，换成内存大小固定的层：2024年AI21的Jamba；2025年的MiniMax-01和英伟达的Nemotron-H；然后是Qwen3-Next和月之暗面的Kimi Linear，每三个这样的层配一个注意力层。<bookmark mark='b'/>到2026年，旗舰模型都是这样造的，或者用稀疏注意力。2月的Qwen3.5：三比一的混合架构。同月的GLM-5：7440亿个参数，用DeepSeek的稀疏注意力。<bookmark mark='c'/>4月的DeepSeek-V4：1.6万亿个参数，压缩稀疏注意力，一百万词元的上下文。还有7月的Kimi K3：2.8万亿个参数，69层Kimi Delta注意力，24层潜在注意力。<bookmark mark='d'/>第15和第16部分会把它们拆开来看。2023年的趋同是真的，但那只是一次停顿：当上下文变长、模型变稀疏，设计又开始分化了。

584f24ca7198.en: How far behind the closed frontier are the open models? One independent index, from Artificial Analysis, scores models on ten evaluations. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here is the best closed model's score over time, <bookmark mark='b'/> and the best open model's. <bookmark mark='c'/> For each new open record, ask when a closed model first scored as high. Across all of them, the median lag is 4.4 months. <bookmark mark='d'/> Since 2025 the median lag has been 4.1 months, about the same as before: the open models follow closely, but they have not closed the gap. The latest open record, MiMo-V2.6-Pro, trailed by 3.4 months.
584f24ca7198.zh: 开放模型落后闭源前沿多远？有一个独立的指数，来自Artificial Analysis，用十项评测给模型打分。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是最好的闭源模型的分数随时间的变化，<bookmark mark='b'/>这是最好的开放模型的。<bookmark mark='c'/>对每一个新的开放模型纪录，问一问：闭源模型最早什么时候达到同样的分数。所有这些落后时间的中位数是4.4个月。<bookmark mark='d'/>2025年以来，落后时间的中位数是4.1个月，和以前差不多：开放模型跟得很紧，但还没有缩小差距。最新的开放模型纪录MiMo-V2.6-Pro，落后了3.4个月。

f83a21ec8a0f.en: Chapter twelve. Compute, cost, and data.

06e4f2cbc9f3.en: Line up the training compute of the models in this part, on a scale where each step up is a hundred times more. <bookmark mark='a'/> The 2017 Transformer: two times ten to the nineteen operations. GPT-1, BERT, GPT-2, T5. <bookmark mark='b'/> GPT-3: three times ten to the twenty-three. PaLM. <bookmark mark='c'/> GPT-4, about two times ten to the twenty-five by Epoch AI's estimate; Llama 3.1, 3.8 times ten to the twenty-five, as Meta reported; and xAI's Grok 3, in 2025, about 3.5 times ten to the twenty-six, again an outside estimate. <bookmark mark='d'/> In 7.7 years, a factor of about 15 million.
06e4f2cbc9f3.zh: 把本部分各个模型的训练算力排成一列，纵轴每往上一格就是一百倍。<bookmark mark='a'/>2017年的Transformer：2乘以10的19次方次运算。GPT-1、BERT、GPT-2、T5。<bookmark mark='b'/>GPT-3：3乘以10的23次方。PaLM。<bookmark mark='c'/>GPT-4，按Epoch AI的估计，大约2乘以10的25次方；Llama 3.1，按Meta的报告，3.8乘以10的25次方；还有2025年xAI的Grok 3，大约3.5乘以10的26次方，同样是外部估计。<bookmark mark='d'/>在7.7年里，增长了大约1500万倍。

02b71b122608.en: How fast is that, as a rate? Epoch AI keeps a database of notable models. Here are the language models it marks as frontier, those near the top in compute when they appeared, since 2017. <bookmark mark='a'/> Fit a straight line to the logarithm of the compute against the date. <bookmark mark='b'/> The slope, b, comes out at 0.709 powers of ten per year. <bookmark mark='c'/> So the compute grows by a factor of ten to the b: about 5.1 times a year. <bookmark mark='d'/> It doubles every 5.1 months. Epoch's own analysis puts frontier models at four to five times a year. Our fit agrees with theirs.
02b71b122608.zh: 换成增长率，这有多快？Epoch AI维护着一个重要模型的数据库。这里是它标为前沿的语言模型，也就是出现时算力接近最高的那些，从2017年开始。<bookmark mark='a'/>用一条直线拟合算力的对数和日期的关系。<bookmark mark='b'/>斜率b是每年0.709个数量级。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以算力每年增长10的b次方倍：大约5.1倍。<bookmark mark='d'/>每5.1个月翻一番。Epoch自己的分析认为，前沿模型每年增长4到5倍。我们的拟合和他们的一致。

bcd7188b86d7.en: Cost grew more slowly than compute, because each operation got cheaper, but it grew. <bookmark mark='a'/> Epoch AI estimates that the hardware and energy for GPT-4's final training run cost about forty million dollars, and Gemini Ultra's about thirty. <bookmark mark='b'/> Across frontier models, costs grew about 2.4 times a year since 2016; on that trend, the largest runs pass a billion dollars by 2027. <bookmark mark='c'/> Against that, DeepSeek reported about 5.6 million dollars for V3's final run: what sparse models, careful engineering and cheap 8-bit arithmetic buy. Like every such figure, it leaves out the research and the failed runs before the final one.
bcd7188b86d7.zh: 成本增长得比算力慢，因为每次运算变便宜了，但它还是在增长。<bookmark mark='a'/>Epoch AI估计，GPT-4最后一次训练的硬件和能耗大约花了四千万美元，Gemini Ultra大约三千万美元。<bookmark mark='b'/>在前沿模型中，2016年以来成本每年增长大约2.4倍；照这个趋势，最大的训练到2027年会超过十亿美元。<bookmark mark='c'/>与之相比，DeepSeek报告V3的最后一次训练大约花了560万美元：这是稀疏模型、精心的工程和便宜的8位运算换来的。和所有这类数字一样，它没有算上之前的研究和失败的训练。

93735454a65e.en: Finally the data: how many tokens each model read per parameter. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 2020 and 2021, GPT-3 and Gopher read fewer than two tokens per parameter. <bookmark mark='b'/> Chinchilla, in 2022, showed that about twenty is compute-optimal. <bookmark mark='c'/> Since then, open models have gone far past it: LLaMA's 7-billion-parameter model a hundred and fifty, DeepSeek-V3 four hundred per active parameter, and Qwen3's smallest model, 0.6 billion parameters, read about 36 trillion tokens: 60,000 per parameter. <bookmark mark='d'/> Small models are over-trained on purpose, because they are the ones that run most often. And good text is finite: where the tokens come from is Part 18.
93735454a65e.zh: 最后是数据：每个模型平均每个参数读了多少个词元。<bookmark mark='a'/>2020和2021年，GPT-3和Gopher每个参数读的词元不到两个。<bookmark mark='b'/>2022年的Chinchilla表明，大约20个是计算最优的。<bookmark mark='c'/>从那以后，开放模型远远超过了这个数：LLaMA的70亿参数模型是150个，DeepSeek-V3按激活参数算是400个，而Qwen3最小的模型，6亿个参数，读了大约36万亿个词元：每个参数60000个。<bookmark mark='d'/>小模型是故意被过度训练的，因为它们运行得最频繁。而好的文本是有限的：词元从哪里来，是第18部分的内容。

be73059218a3.en: Chapter thirteen. Our own lineage: GPT against BERT.
be73059218a3.zh: 第13章。我们自己的谱系：GPT对BERT。

40d6ac7321cf.en: Now our own version of the 2018 question. Two models with exactly the same shape: 4 layers, a width of 128, 4 heads, 1.83 million parameters, built from the modern block of chapter ten. <bookmark mark='a'/> They start from identical weights and read the same 3.0 million tokens of the thirty novels, in the same order, with the same optimizer and learning-rate schedule. <bookmark mark='b'/> Only two things differ. The GPT-style model's attention looks back only, and it predicts every next token. The BERT-style model's attention looks both ways, and it predicts the fifteen percent of tokens we hide. <bookmark mark='c'/> So the compute is identical: six, times the parameters each token passes through, times the tokens. <bookmark mark='d'/> That is what fair means here: the same model, the same data, the same compute, with only the objective changed; and then a test on tasks both can do.
40d6ac7321cf.zh: 现在来做我们自己版本的2018年之问。两个形状完全相同的模型：4层，宽度128，4个头，1.83百万个参数，用第10章的现代模块搭成。<bookmark mark='a'/>它们从完全相同的权重出发，按相同的顺序读三十部小说里同样的3.0百万个词元，用同样的优化器和学习率安排。<bookmark mark='b'/>只有两处不同。GPT式模型的注意力只往回看，它预测每一个下一个词元。BERT式模型的注意力两边都看，它预测我们遮住的那15%的词元。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以算力完全相同：6，乘以每个词元经过的参数，再乘以词元数。<bookmark mark='d'/>这就是这里所说的公平：同样的模型，同样的数据，同样的算力，只换了目标函数；然后在两个模型都能做的任务上测试。

1f9bc6876911.en: Watch the GPT-style model learn. On the left, its loss on held-out text as training goes on; on the right, what it writes after the words 'The door opened, and', frozen at each checkpoint, with the same random seed every time. <bookmark mark='a'/> Untrained, its loss is 8.34 nats per token, about what guessing uniformly among four thousand tokens gives, and it writes noise. <bookmark mark='b'/> Let it read. Each dot is the loss on text it never trains on, and the faint line is the loss on the batches it does train on. The checkpoints are spaced out geometrically: close together early, when it changes fastest. The two stay together: it is learning the language of the novels, not memorizing its batches. <bookmark mark='c'/> By the end, the loss is 4.55 nats, and it writes something like the novels it read: not sense yet, but their words and rhythm.
1f9bc6876911.zh: 看GPT式模型学习。左边是它在留出文本上的损失随训练的变化；右边是它在“The door opened, and”这几个词后面写出的东西，在每个检查点冻结，每次都用同一个随机种子。<bookmark mark='a'/>未训练时，它的损失是每个词元8.34奈特，差不多就是在四千个词元里均匀乱猜的水平，写出来的是噪声。<bookmark mark='b'/>让它读下去。每个点是它在从不用来训练的文本上的损失，淡淡的线是它在训练批次上的损失。检查点按几何级数分布：前面密，因为那时变化最快。两者一直靠在一起：它在学小说的语言，而不是在背它的训练批次。<bookmark mark='c'/>到最后，损失是4.55奈特，它写出的东西有点像它读过的小说：还谈不上意思，但有了小说的用词和节奏。

c9f95d7034a4.en: The BERT-style model learns to fill blanks. Here is a sentence with three words hidden, and its best guess for each, at the same checkpoints. <bookmark mark='a'/> Its loss is measured only on the hidden words, and it falls to 4.89 nats. <bookmark mark='b'/> It is higher than the GPT-style model's 4.55, but the two can't be compared: guessing a hidden word with both sides visible is a different problem from guessing the next word, and the masked model learned from only fifteen percent of the tokens. To compare the two models fairly, we need tasks both can do.
c9f95d7034a4.zh: BERT式模型学的是填空。这里有一个句子，遮住了三个词，下面是它在同样的检查点上对每个词的最佳猜测。<bookmark mark='a'/>它的损失只在被遮住的词上计算，降到了4.89奈特。<bookmark mark='b'/>它比GPT式模型的4.55还高，但两者没法比较：两边都看得见时猜一个被遮住的词，和猜下一个词是不同的问题，而且掩码模型只从15%的词元里学习。要公平地比较这两个模型，我们需要两个都能做的任务。

86395a6948c4.en: Task one: fill in a blank. Take a sentence from a paragraph neither model has read, remove one word, and offer 8 candidates: the real word and 7 others about as common. <bookmark mark='a'/> The BERT-style model reads the sentence with a mask in the gap and picks the candidate it rates most likely. The GPT-style model can't see past the gap, but it can put each candidate in place and compare the probabilities of the whole sentences, which uses the words after the gap too. For contrast, we also let it judge from the words before the gap alone. <bookmark mark='b'/> On 600 sentences, with chance at 12.5 percent: from the left only, the GPT-style model gets 61.5 percent. <bookmark mark='c'/> Scoring the whole sentence, 81.7. <bookmark mark='d'/> Here the GPT-style model wins, 81.7 percent against 59.7: scoring whole sentences lets it use the words after the gap too, and it learned from every token, not fifteen percent.
86395a6948c4.zh: 任务一：填空。从两个模型都没读过的段落里取一个句子，去掉一个词，给出8个候选：真正的那个词，加上7个差不多常见的词。<bookmark mark='a'/>BERT式模型读的是空缺处放着掩码的句子，挑出它认为可能性最大的候选。GPT式模型看不到空缺后面，但它可以把每个候选放进去，比较整句话的概率，这样也用上了空缺后面的词。作为对照，我们也让它只根据空缺前面的词来判断。<bookmark mark='b'/>在600个句子上，随机猜的正确率是12.5%：只看左边，GPT式模型答对61.5%。<bookmark mark='c'/>给整句打分，答对81.7%。<bookmark mark='d'/>这里GPT式模型赢了，81.7%对59.7%：给整句打分让它也能用上空缺后面的词，而且它从每一个词元学习，而不只是15%。

f7155ba21ff5.en: Task two is the kind of test GLUE was made of: classify a sentence. Which of the thirty novels is it from? <bookmark mark='a'/> Freeze each model, run a sentence through it, average its final states over the sentence, and train the same simple linear classifier on top, for each model the same way. <bookmark mark='b'/> Chance is 3.3 percent. <bookmark mark='c'/> Here the GPT-style model's features do better, 15.2 percent against 10.3: at our small scale, learning from every token seems to matter more than seeing both ways.
f7155ba21ff5.zh: 任务二是GLUE里那种测试：给一个句子分类。它出自三十部小说中的哪一部？<bookmark mark='a'/>把每个模型冻结，让一个句子通过它，对整句的最终状态取平均，再在上面训练同样的简单线性分类器，每个模型都用同样的方法。<bookmark mark='b'/>随机猜的正确率是3.3%。<bookmark mark='c'/>这里GPT式模型的特征更好，15.2%对10.3%：在我们这么小的规模上，从每个词元学习，似乎比能看两边更重要。

be219de6ca5e.en: And the task only one of them can really do: write. <bookmark mark='a'/> Given the opening, the GPT-style model samples one token after another. <bookmark mark='b'/> The BERT-style model can be made to write by putting a mask at the end and filling it, again and again, but it was never trained to guess a word with nothing after it. <bookmark mark='c'/> And only the causal model gives a probability to a whole text, by the chain rule of Part 1, so only it joins the scoreboard: on the Maltese Falcon passage, 2.05 bits per character. A masked model's guesses don't multiply into the probability of a text, so it has no row. <bookmark mark='d'/> That is the deeper reason the decoder won. A model of the probability of text can be sampled, scored and prompted: one model does everything, and it gets better with scale.
be219de6ca5e.zh: 还有一个只有其中一个模型真正能做的任务：写作。<bookmark mark='a'/>给出开头，GPT式模型一个词元接一个词元地采样。<bookmark mark='b'/>BERT式模型也可以被逼着写：在末尾放一个掩码，填上，再放，再填，但它从来没被训练过在后面什么都没有的情况下猜一个词。<bookmark mark='c'/>而且只有因果模型能通过第1部分的链式法则给整段文本一个概率，所以只有它能进入记分板：在《马耳他之鹰》那段文字上，每个字符2.05比特。掩码模型的猜测乘不出一段文本的概率，所以它没有这一行。<bookmark mark='d'/>这就是解码器胜出的更深层原因。一个文本概率的模型，可以采样、可以打分、可以用提示来驱动：一个模型包揽一切，而且规模越大越好。

67f5e105ba40.en: Chapter fourteen. Learning in context, in our own models.
67f5e105ba40.zh: 第14章。在我们自己的模型里，在上下文中学习。

29c1eb1c6b32.en: GPT-3's surprise was that learning from the prompt appeared with scale. Can we see any of it at our scale? <bookmark mark='a'/> Four GPT-style models of growing size, all trained on the same text, the same number of tokens. <bookmark mark='b'/> First, the simplest measure of learning from context: the loss at each position of a 256-token window. Early positions have almost no context; later ones have a lot. <bookmark mark='c'/> Every curve falls from left to right: the words before help. From one to four tokens of context to more than a hundred, the smallest model gains 0.23 nats per token; the 4.2 million-parameter model gains 0.46: the bigger models learn more from context. <bookmark mark='t'/>
29c1eb1c6b32.zh: GPT-3带来的意外是：从提示中学习，是随着规模出现的。在我们的规模上，能看到一点吗？<bookmark mark='a'/>四个大小递增的GPT式模型，都在同样的文本上训练，读同样多的词元。<bookmark mark='b'/>先看从上下文中学习最简单的度量：在一个256词元的窗口里，每个位置上的损失。前面的位置几乎没有上下文，后面的位置有很多。<bookmark mark='c'/>每条曲线都从左往右下降：前面的词有帮助。从一到四个词元的上下文，到一百多个，最小的模型每个词元提升了0.23奈特；家族中最大的模型提升了0.46奈特：越大的模型，从上下文中学到的越多。<bookmark mark='t'/>

681175c8cd16.en: Now replay the training of the largest of the family, and watch that curve form. On the left, its held-out loss; on the right, its loss at each position of the context, frozen at each checkpoint. <bookmark mark='a'/> Untrained, the curve is flat: a model that knows nothing gains nothing from context. <bookmark mark='b'/> As it trains, the whole curve drops, and it tilts: the positions with more context fall further. <bookmark mark='c'/> By the end its held-out loss is 4.48 nats, and the curve has the shape we just saw for model L.
681175c8cd16.zh: 现在重放家族中最大的模型的训练过程，看那条曲线是怎么形成的。左边是它在留出文本上的损失；右边是它在上下文每个位置上的损失，在每个检查点冻结。<bookmark mark='a'/>未训练时，曲线是平的：一个什么都不懂的模型，从上下文里什么也得不到。<bookmark mark='b'/>随着训练，整条曲线下降，而且倾斜起来：上下文越多的位置，降得越多。<bookmark mark='c'/>到最后，它的留出损失是4.48奈特，曲线就是我们刚才看到的模型L的样子。

4e94f8cc6e92.en: A sharper test, the one Part 13 used: a list of sixty random common words, then the same list again. A model that can copy from its context finds the second copy much easier than the first. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here is how often each model guesses the next word, on the first copy and on the second. <bookmark mark='b'/> <bookmark mark='v'/> None of our models does much better the second time: the best gains 0 points. At our scale and training length, the copying circuit, the induction heads of Part 13, hasn't formed; Part 13's small transformer couldn't copy either. <bookmark mark='w'/>
4e94f8cc6e92.zh: 一个更尖锐的测试，第13部分用过的：一张由六十个随机常用词组成的列表，然后把同一张列表再来一遍。一个能从上下文中复制的模型，会觉得第二遍比第一遍容易得多。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是每个模型在第一遍和第二遍上猜对下一个词的频率。<bookmark mark='b'/><bookmark mark='v'/>我们没有一个模型在第二遍上明显更好：最好的也只提高了0个百分点。在我们的规模和训练长度下，复制的回路，也就是第13部分的归纳头，还没有形成；第13部分那个小Transformer也不会复制。<bookmark mark='w'/>

19c81834adc3.en: Finally, GPT-3's own kind of test, built from the novels. Two books; a few labelled examples in the prompt, each a sentence and the book it is from; then a new sentence from a paragraph the models never read, and we compare the probabilities they give to the two titles. <bookmark mark='a'/> Small models tend to favour one title whatever the sentence, so, as Tony Zhao and colleagues proposed in 2021, we first subtract the score each title gets after a sentence with no content at all. <bookmark mark='d'/> With zero, one, two, four and eight examples, for every model. <bookmark mark='b'/> With no examples the models are near chance, at most 52 percent. <bookmark mark='c'/> For model L, examples barely matter: 52 percent with none, 53 with 8. <bookmark mark='e'/> With 8 examples, the family's sizes are within 2 points of each other.
19c81834adc3.zh: 最后，是GPT-3自己那种测试，用小说搭成。两本书；提示里有几个带标签的例子，每个例子是一个句子加上它出自哪本书；然后是一个来自模型从没读过的段落的新句子，我们比较模型给两个书名的概率。<bookmark mark='a'/>小模型往往不管句子是什么，都偏爱某一个书名，所以，按照Tony Zhao和同事在2021年提出的办法，我们先减去每个书名在一个毫无内容的句子后面得到的分数。<bookmark mark='d'/>每个模型都试零个、一个、两个、四个和八个例子。<bookmark mark='b'/>没有例子时，模型接近随机猜，最高52%。<bookmark mark='c'/>对模型L来说，例子几乎没有影响：没有例子时52%，8个例子时53%。<bookmark mark='e'/>在8个例子时，家族中各个大小的模型彼此相差在2个百分点以内。

56bcd8095e14.en: So what did our small models show? <bookmark mark='a'/> Our models use their context more as they grow. <bookmark mark='f'/> Copying from the context hasn't appeared at our scale. <bookmark mark='g'/> But learning a task from examples in the prompt hasn't appeared at our scale. <bookmark mark='b'/> In GPT-3's own plots, few-shot learning became useful only in the billions of parameters. Part 13 showed the mechanism, heads that find and copy; Part 12, the scaling laws that make larger models worth their cost.
56bcd8095e14.zh: 那么，我们的小模型说明了什么？<bookmark mark='a'/>我们的模型越大，越会利用上下文。<bookmark mark='f'/>在我们的规模上，从上下文中复制还没有出现。<bookmark mark='g'/>但从提示里的例子中学会一个任务，在我们的规模上还没有出现。<bookmark mark='b'/>在GPT-3自己的图里，少样本学习要到几十亿参数才变得有用。第13部分给出了机制，也就是会查找和复制的注意力头；第12部分给出了让更大的模型物有所值的规模定律。

a0cfe0e7ad60.en: Before the recap, here is the whole lineage on one page, with time running left to right. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 2017, the Transformer: an encoder and a decoder, built to translate. <bookmark mark='b'/> Within two years it had split into three branches: encoders, like BERT, which won the benchmarks; encoder-decoders, like T5; and decoders, like GPT. <bookmark mark='c'/> The decoder branch scaled: GPT-3, Codex, InstructGPT, ChatGPT, GPT-4. And as it scaled, it closed. <bookmark mark='d'/> From 2023, open lanes appear beside it: Meta's LLaMA, then Mistral, each built on the published designs before it. <bookmark mark='e'/> Then DeepSeek, Moonshot's Kimi, Alibaba's Qwen, and even OpenAI again, with open weights. <bookmark mark='f'/> Every open model at today's frontier is a decoder. The encoders live on, in search and classification, but the frontier grew from one branch.
a0cfe0e7ad60.zh: 在回顾之前，先把整个谱系放在一页上，时间从左往右走。<bookmark mark='a'/>2017年，Transformer：一个编码器加一个解码器，为翻译而造。<bookmark mark='b'/>不到两年，它分成了三支：编码器，比如赢下各项基准的BERT；编码器-解码器，比如T5；还有解码器，比如GPT。<bookmark mark='c'/>解码器这一支扩大了规模：GPT-3、Codex、InstructGPT、ChatGPT、GPT-4。而随着规模扩大，它也封闭了。<bookmark mark='d'/>从2023年起，旁边出现了开放的分支：Meta的LLaMA，然后是Mistral，每一个都建立在之前公开的设计之上。<bookmark mark='e'/>然后是DeepSeek、月之暗面的Kimi、阿里巴巴的Qwen，甚至OpenAI也再次开放了权重。<bookmark mark='f'/>今天前沿上的每一个开放模型，都是解码器。编码器还活着，用在搜索和分类里，但前沿是从这一支长出来的。

3f14a52d2ac1.en: Let's take stock. In 2017 a translation model made attention the whole architecture. In 2018, pretraining on raw text, then fine-tuning, became the recipe, and masked models like BERT won the benchmarks of the day. Then the decoder scaled: GPT-2 did tasks it was never trained for, and GPT-3, at three times ten to the twenty-three operations, learned from examples in its prompt. Instruction tuning and human feedback turned it into ChatGPT. Open models converged on one recipe, then grew sparse and began to diverge again, while compute grew about five times a year. And on our own small models, at equal compute, we measured what each objective buys.
3f14a52d2ac1.zh: 来盘点一下。2017年，一个翻译模型让注意力成了整个架构。2018年，先在原始文本上预训练、再微调，成了标准做法，而像BERT这样的掩码模型赢下了当时的基准。然后解码器开始扩大规模：GPT-2能做从没训练过的任务，而GPT-3用了3乘以10的23次方次运算，能从提示里的例子中学习。指令微调和人类反馈把它变成了ChatGPT。开放模型先趋同到同一套配方，然后变得稀疏，又开始分化，与此同时算力每年增长大约5倍。而在我们自己的小模型上，在同样的算力下，我们测出了每种目标函数能换来什么。

59f890c691ea.en: All of this comes back. The memory of past tokens, latent attention and hybrids are Part 15. Mixtures of experts and sparse attention, Part 16. The hardware that made scale possible, Part 17, and how a frontier run is actually organized, Part 18. Serving these models cheaply, Part 19. Instruction tuning and human feedback, built on our own model, Part 27; and reasoning, Part 28.
59f890c691ea.zh: 这一切都会再出现。过去词元的记忆、潜在注意力和混合架构，是第15部分。混合专家和稀疏注意力，第16部分。让规模成为可能的硬件，第17部分；一次前沿训练实际上是怎么组织的，第18部分。便宜地部署这些模型，第19部分。在我们自己的模型上实现指令微调和人类反馈，第27部分；还有推理，第28部分。

5e943a199af9.en: Here are six problems to try, from counting GPT-3's parameters to the trends of the last chapter. Pause here, and work through them; full solutions are in this part's notes.
5e943a199af9.zh: 这里有六道题，从数GPT-3的参数，到上一章的趋势。在这里暂停，把它们做一做；完整的解答在本部分的笔记里。

daee6f16f6c0.en: Next time: memory. A model reading a million tokens has to keep something of every one of them. <bookmark mark='a'/> Grouped-query and latent attention shrink the cache that grows with every token; <bookmark mark='b'/> linear attention, the delta rule and state-space models replace it with a memory of fixed size; and the hybrids of this part's frontier mix the two. That is Part 15.
daee6f16f6c0.zh: 下一次：记忆。一个读一百万个词元的模型，必须为其中每一个都留下点什么。<bookmark mark='a'/>分组查询注意力和潜在注意力，缩小了随每个词元增长的缓存；<bookmark mark='b'/>线性注意力、delta规则和状态空间模型，用一个大小固定的记忆来代替它；而本部分前沿上的混合架构，把两者结合了起来。这就是第15部分。

339683dafdce.en: The history in this part is best read in the papers themselves, most of them short and clear. Thanks for watching, and see you in Part 15.
339683dafdce.zh: 本部分讲的历史，最好去读论文原文，它们大多简短而清楚。感谢观看，第15部分见。
